displayIdentity.body: Peter calls for humility under God’s hand and for casting anxiety on him. He also calls for clear thinking and watchfulness because the devil prowls like a roaring lion. Readers must resist him in faith amid shared suffering. God will restore and strengthen them, and dominion belongs to him.
displayIdentity.title: The adversary prowls like a lion and is resisted in faith
